scope: All 182 target identities have primary-source metadata evidence. Verification is not a claim that all are peer-reviewed full papers, that all papers were read line by line, or that scientific results were independently validated.
historical_record_policy: Preserve historical search titles, decisions, coding, access limits and counts; metadata corrections and later publication status are recorded in separate linked tables. Internal tool locators removed from public copies.
limitations: Search counts are observed result records, not engine-total estimates or systematic-review denominators.
Different source targets can represent the same work or different versions. Do not add target counts to historical family counts.
A live primary page, indexed primary metadata or a corroborating primary version verifies identity; source-specific access and version limitations are retained in notes.
Review status is independent of formal publication status and document length/type.
No publisher paper PDFs, full-text article copies, or credentials are distributed.
